csv_project_name: DB Service for Traction Power Substation
csv_scope_of_work: The Metropolitan Transit Authority of Harris County (METRO) is conducting a Request for Information (RFI) from interested parties regarding Substation Hardware Replacement. Metro is evaluating procurement strategies for replacement of hardware within existing traction power substations. Current design is approximately 30% complete. Due to the hardware and installation driven nature of the work, METRO is considering offering this contract as a Progressive Design-Build to integrate the hardware manufacturer and installer into the design process and have a single point of responsibility and delivery.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Design Build/Developer, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering
